name: Snyk
summary: Developer security platform that embeds vulnerability detection into software delivery.
overview: Snyk helps developers find and remediate security issues across code and dependencies.
bull_case: Security integrated into the developer workflow can become a high-retention control point.
bear_case: Platform vendors and budget scrutiny may limit pricing and expansion.

intelligence.description: Snyk provides developer-focused security tools for finding and fixing vulnerabilities across code, open source dependencies, containers and cloud configurations.
company: Snyk embeds security testing into developer workflows, helping engineering teams identify issues before software reaches production.
Its platform strategy combines open-source security, code scanning, cloud security and application security posture management.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Snyk is a key private benchmark for the developer-security market. Its next liquidity event will test how investors value security platforms built around developer adoption in a tighter software market.

changed.text: Raised close to $200M in a late-stage funding round led by Qatar Investment Authority.
Continued to position AI and developer workflows as central to modern application security.

takeaways: Developer distribution is a durable advantage in security software.
The last public funding mark predates the current AI-led software cycle.
A new financing or IPO would provide a more current valuation signal.
